purpose: Teach: 聴け/ダラダラ/働け/蹴っ/滑らか/呑み/噛ん/食費

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔のラジオ、夜遅くまで聴けば、楽しかった。
lines.en: Old radio — I could listen late into the night, and it made those hours feel good.
lines.style: Soft, drifting. Eyes looking past the present moment. Warm memory in the tone, no urgency. Let the thought float.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。引退してから、ダラダラの時間、増えたわね。
lines.en: Yes. Since I retired, there's been so much more of this… idle time.
lines.style: Gentle agreement, almost to herself. A small laugh underneath — not complaint, just observation. Comfortable silence ready to follow.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、もっと働けばよかった、なんて思わない。
lines.en: I don't regret it — not for a moment. Never thought 'I should have worked more' back then.
lines.style: Steady, firm but not harsh. A small correction, almost protective of his younger self. Measured pace. This is something he's made peace with.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、サッカーボール、お互い蹴って遊んだわね。
lines.en: Back then, we used to kick a soccer ball around together, remember? We were so carefree.
lines.style: Reaching back through time. Slight brightness comes in on the memory itself. Tender gaze, not at her but at the image of them younger. Pace slows on 'carefree.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前の肌、年取っても、滑らかなところ、残ってる。
lines.en: Even now, after all these years, your skin is still soft. That part of you hasn't changed.
lines.style: Quiet, almost hesitant at the start — unsure if it's okay to say this aloud. Then gentle certainty. Eyes on her. No performance, just noticing something he's always noticed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祝いの席で、ワイン、軽く呑みましょう。
lines.en: When we're celebrating something, let's have a glass of wine together. Just a light one.
lines.style: Inviting, practical warmth. A small invitation wrapped in the ordinary. Slight lilt up at the end — hope, not demand. This is how they do things.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔のおせんべい、よく噛んで食べたな。
lines.en: I remember those old crackers — you had to chew them well. We savored everything back then.
lines.style: Drifting into the detail of it. Almost tasting the memory. Unhurried. The small pleasures come into focus. Breath steady and low.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 年金生活、食費、二人で工夫しているわね。
lines.en: Living on pension, we watch our food budget carefully. But we make it work together, the two of us.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath practical warmth. A knowing glance — they've figured this out. No strain in the delivery, just the calm of people who know how to stretch what they have.
